key: Complex Burst Q-less QR Decomposition with Forgetting Factor Whole R Output
title: Complex Burst Q-less QR Decomposition with Forgetting Factor Whole R Output
source_docs: Fixed-Point Designer HDL Support/Matrices and Linear Algebra/Matrix Factorizations/Complex_Burst_Q_less_QR_Decomposition_with_Forgetting_Factor_Wh.md
text: 具有无限行数的复值矩阵的无 Q QR 分解，输入 3 路、输出 3 路；{Number of columns in matrix A} 指定输入矩阵 A 的列数、{Forgetting factor} 指定对矩阵的每一行进行分解后应用的遗忘因子、{Regularization parameter} 指定正则化参数，按实例取值。

ports.name: A(i,:)
ports.summary: 复值矩阵 A 的行 vector

ports.name: validIn
ports.summary: 输入是否有效 Boolean scalar

ports.name: restart
ports.summary: 是否清除内部状态 Boolean scalar

ports.name: R
ports.summary: 经济型 QR 分解矩阵 R vector

ports.name: validOut
ports.summary: 输出数据是否有效 Boolean scalar

ports.name: ready
ports.summary: 模块是否就绪 Boolean scalar

params.name: Number of columns in matrix A
params.values: 输入矩阵 A 的列数 4 (default) | positive integer-valued scalar

params.name: Forgetting factor
params.values: 对矩阵的每一行进行分解后应用的遗忘因子 0.99 (default) | real positive scalar

params.name: Regularization parameter
params.values: 正则化参数 0 (default) | real nonnegative scalar
